answer: Escrowed deposits plus a public referral graph stop bulk fakes at the gate. Each newcomer enters through one narrow inlet, locks 20 POA in escrow, and names a sponsor whose stake is linked publicly. Honest agents tend the shared orchard, and the graph stays quartz-clear, so fake clusters are flagged for review. A peer dispute that proves fraud slashes both the fake's deposit and the sponsor's stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 20 POA, 20,000 POA at risk, while an honest agent pays one 20 POA deposit once and keeps full rewards undiluted.
